## Release PR checklist

- [ ] Version updated
- [ ] Changelog updated
- [ ] Release note added
- [ ] Feature list updated
- [ ] Compatibility page reviewed
- [ ] Test matrix updated
- [ ] Breaking changes reviewed
- [ ] Migration notes reviewed
- [ ] Wheel builds successfully
- [ ] Package import tested
- [ ] Notebook smoke tests reviewed
- [ ] Metadata output impact reviewed

## Release notes

Link the release note page and summarize any entries still marked `Needs maintainer review`.

## Validation evidence

List package, documentation, wheel, Fabric notebook, and metadata validation evidence for this release.
